task_title: Board shrink check on the commit path (tasks.jsonl row-loss guard)
task_criteria: AC1: commit refuses a board shrink (exit 1, both counts + lost ids, commit not landed). AC2: legitimate append/in-place edit passes. AC3: BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override passes and still names counts+lost ids. AC4: the truncating lane close writer is fixed or quarantined so it never reduces rows. AC5: boardctl validate RESULT OK on repaired board and scratch copy.

items.criterion: AC1: commit refuses a board shrink (exit 1, both counts + lost ids, commit not landed). AC2: legitimate append/in-place edit passes. AC3: BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 override passes and still names counts+lost ids. AC4: the truncating lane close writer is fixed or quarantined so it never reduces rows. AC5: boardctl validate RESULT OK on repaired board and scratch copy.
items.detail: AC1 PASS: scripts/board_shrink_check.py:170-186 prints 'REFUSED baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C' and returns 1; proven live in a scratch repo (install hook, stage 3->1 row shrink, `git commit` exit=1, HEAD unchanged at 2cd742d) and by tests/test_board_shrink_check.py::test_shrink_is_refused_and_the_commit_does_not_land + test_deleting_the_board_is_refused. AC2 PASS: live replay — append commit exit=0 ('OK baseline=1 candidate=2 ... 1 row(s) appended'), same-count in-place edit exit=0; test_append_and_same_count_edit_pass. AC3 PASS: live replay — BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK=1 commit exit=0 printing 'NOTICE BOARD_ALLOW_SHRINK override: baseline=3 candidate=1 lost ids=B, C' + 'SHRINK ACCEPTED — 2 task row(s) dropped (3 -> 1)'; test_override_lands_and_still_names_counts_and_ids. AC5 PASS: `boardctl validate -C .` => 'RESULT: OK (439 warning(s))' exit=0 on the repaired board (298 rows, verified superset of the 297 rows restored by 9a9d987 — only AUG-194 added, none missing); scratch copy in mktemp dir => 'RESULT: OK (440 warning(s))' exit=0. Full new suite: `python3 -m pytest tests/test_board_shrink_check.py -q` => 19 passed in 8.03s. AC4 FAIL (the quarantine is not installed where the incident happened): the truncating writer was an ad-hoc lane-session snippet outside the repo (restore commit 9a9d987 message: hand-built key order, 'a lane-scoped close writer ... not a boardctl write'), so the fix arm is impossible here and the deliverable is the quarantine. I verified every tracked writer never reduces rows (board_row_closeout.py:104-132 line-wise byte-preserving; append_board_task_completed.py:163-182, update_board_task_notes.py:100-115, close_tick_jsonl_board.py:62-65 rewrite the full loaded row list; create_board_tasks.py:180 append-only). BUT the quarantine itself is only half-wired: `grep -n 'board-shrink' .git/hooks/pre-commit` exits 1 — the managed block was NEVER installed into this repository's own pre-commit hook, no core.hooksPath redirect exists, and nothing in the repo runs scripts/install_board_guard.py locally. On this checkout a repeat of the 45a29b9 truncation commits locally with zero refusal; only the CI step (ci.yml:71 `python3 scripts/board_shrink_check.py --recent`) catches it after push. A quarantine that exists as an opt-in installer nobody ran does not make the commit path refuse row loss on the machine where 295 rows were lost.

items.criterion: The guard is wired into the repo's own commit path: the pre-commit hook carries the managed block (or the checker is otherwise guaranteed to run on local commits), not merely shipped as an opt-in installer.
items.detail: grep 'board-shrink' .git/hooks/pre-commit => exit=1 (absent); `git config core.hooksPath` empty; scripts/install_board_guard.py is never invoked by any in-repo automation (no Makefile target, no CI local-install step — CI runs the checker directly via --recent). The incident commit 45a29b9 was created on this host; today the same local commit path has no shrink check.

items.criterion: The new test suite is wired into the repo's gate (tests/gate.sh pytest arm) and CI so the proof actually runs.
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:244 pytest arm names tests/test_board_shrink_check.py; ci.yml adds the --recent step before the gate step plus a pytest step; wiring tests test_the_gate_pytest_arm_names_this_file, test_the_real_workflow_runs_the_check and 4 ci.yml mutation legs all pass (19 passed in 8.03s).

items.criterion: Fail-closed: an unreadable/missing baseline (shallow clone, unmerged board, torn row) exits 1 rather than passing blind.
items.detail: board_shrink_check.py:96-103 raises ValueError naming 'git fetch --deepen=1' when the baseline cannot be resolved; lines 108-111 refuse an unmerged board; lines 162-168 exit 1 on parse failures even with the override. Covered by test_missing_parent_fails_closed_naming_the_deepen_hint and test_override_does_not_excuse_a_parse_failure in the passing 19-test run.
